categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Changes descriptor key derivation in src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp and carries the Wallet label.
categories.rationale: Fixes a wallet correctness bug where ranged descriptor imports derive keys below range_start, temporarily crediting matching transactions during rescan that subsequently disappear from the wallet upon restart. It also eliminates a major performance penalty when importing high-offset ranges (reducing an import from 19.5s to 0.09s in PR benchmarks).
